parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise update-workspace --workspace-id 120000 --workspace-name workspace_xxx --description test --client-token token-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise UpdateWorkspace --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --WorkspaceId 120000 --WorkspaceName workspace_xxx --ClientToken 'token-xxx'
